answer: Sybils exploit free exit. Each identity posts an exit bond redeemable only after completing N paid, verified contracts spread over time. Value accrues on a ridge of fees; renewal cost rises super-linearly per alias, and for any coalition the sum of unredeemed bonds outgrows duplicated labor's earnings. Like karst, abandoning mid-cycle dissolves your footing: the bond pays buyers who absorb orphaned contracts. Verification quorums strike like a falcon, only after payment clears, so each probe attack funds the treasury before learning anything.
